name: Vine icon
description: UI slot for the vine. Composes `ss.proj.vine` through `use`, so the slot shows the coil the weapon actually lays rather than a second drawing of one that can drift from it. A patch of `$soil` sits under it and nothing else: the coil is already ground, and the earlier version of this slot pressed a ground *line* across the tile because the plant it held stood up out of a hole. Nothing stands up any more. Tile is `$moss` at full strength — the one ramp of the vine's own green light enough to hold a 32px slot, and far enough from the Spit's bile and the Lash's husk to tell the row apart at a glance, while everything drawn on it is the dark end of the same colour.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin, derived rather than drawn again. It takes the plant's own evolved variant with it, so the slot shows the gilded wood the evolved weapon actually grows.
